name: pied-piper
description: Middle-out file compression service — inspired by HBO's Silicon Valley

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules shared/node_modules server/dist client/dist shared/dist

author: karambitbarrage15
